headline: Shakti Pumps (India) Limited: Acquisition
sum: Acquisition - Shakti Pumps (India) Limited has informed the Exchange that the Company has invested Rs. 10 Crores in it's Wholly Owned Subsidiary i.e Shakti Energy Solutions Limited.
